title: Read the os-dev report open_questions array, and give a residual question its own card
body:
Fixes #16662

The `os-dev` report contract carries an `open_questions` array. A dev that hits a question only
the maintainer can answer writes it there, with options and a recommendation, exactly as the
contract asks. **Nothing read that array.** The decision inbox is the `needs-user-decision`
label, and a question inside a report comment's JSON body carries no label — so the question was
filed, well-formed and unreachable: not in the inbox, not in any candidate query, not in any
staleness alert, while the card kept a `pm:*` state label that reads as work in flight on every
board.

This PR ships the **reader**, and the rule that lets a question outlive the card it was raised
on. ⛔ It does not touch the report contract: the array is the right place for the question.

## What landed

1. **`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` — H52, one report-only patrol row.** For the NEWEST
   `os-dev-report` on an open card whose complete comment thread is already in hand, a non-empty
   `open_questions` on a card carrying no `needs-user-decision` is a row naming the report, its
   stamp, how many questions it holds and the first of them. Registered in
   `HALF_STATE_FAMILY_BAND` as a `stall` row, with a three-number coverage clause
   (`openQuestionCandidates` / `openQuestionJudged` / `openQuestionUnparsed`) rendered on every
   run.
2. **`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md` — the residual-question rule**,
   two lines in `## 落卡与裁决记录细则`: questions raised while executing a ruling go on a new
   card linking the ruled one, ⛔ never back onto the ruled card as a re-hung label, plus the two
   reasons.

The row **buys nothing**: `commentCache.get` never fetches, so it is judged at the FOOT of the
sweep, after every pass that fills the cache — and above all after H50's completing walk, which
lands the LAST page for every open `pm:dispatched` card. That placement is load-bearing: a
report is posted at the END of a dev round, so on a long thread a first page would miss it, and
miss it silently. A card whose thread nobody bought, or whose thread is in hand but not
complete, or whose newest report payload does not parse, is UNJUDGED — counted apart, never
folded into clean.

## Why the rule sentence sits in the runbook and not in `state-machine.md`

The claim named `state-machine.md` or `decision-analysis.md`, "whichever already carries the
ruled-card rule". Re-checked on this tree: **neither carries it** — `grep` for 呈递 / 已裁卡 over
`SKILL.md` and every `references/*.md` returns the rule nowhere, so that half of the claim's
premise does not hold and the file had to be chosen on a reader instead.

The runbook has a NAMED reader at exactly the moment the rule fires. `SKILL.md:730`, inside
落卡/升级流程 ③ (「答复/代裁到手,四件同笔」 — i.e. a ruling has arrived and is being executed),
points at `references/dispatch-runbook.md` for that step's cases and its two mechanical flags.
The section the sentence landed in, `## 落卡与裁决记录细则`, already carries the decision-box
neighbours it belongs beside (出决策箱须引可取回的裁决 id; the read-side 决策复读 rule) and the two
report-only flags that this very patrol owns. `state-machine.md` is the per-state line contract
for the six labels and has no ruling-execution step; `decision-analysis.md` scopes itself to how
a decision analysis is WRITTEN. So the sentence stays where the previous round put it.

## Acceptance notes

The triage ruling's six-item 验收口径 (comment 5578847560), verbatim, each with its evidence:

> 1. **先跑一次全量扫描并贴出结果**:所有 open 卡上的 `os-dev-report` 评论里 `open_questions` 非空、而卡不带 `needs-user-decision` 的清单。⛔ 这份清单本身就是本卡的第一个交付物 —— 它会告诉我们这个洞现在有多大,而 ⛔ 目前没有人知道。

Posted as comment 5597739635 on the card. **587 open cards read; 65 carriers holding 126
questions, none of them in the inbox.** The full list is in that comment, card by card.

> 2. ⭐ **扫描必须覆盖已关闭的卡至少一次**(见上 #13973 的读数)。⛔ 只扫 open 会漏掉恰恰最难发现的那一类。之后常态运行可以只扫 open,但**首次普查必须包含 closed**,否则得到的是一个系统性偏低的数。

Same comment, section 2: **2,107 closed `pm:dispatched` cards read — 255 carriers holding 436
questions**, i.e. the closed half is larger than the open half and permanently out of reach of
any open query. The standing row is open-only by design and says so in its own coverage clause;
that gap is what the residual-question rule exists to cover.

> 3. **发火对照必须先红**:用一张已知带非空 `open_questions` 且不带标签的卡(第 1 条的扫描结果里任取一张)证明脚本报红;再用一张带标签的证明它不报。⛔ 一个只在修复后跑过一次绿的扫描,与没有扫描无法区分。

Red: all 65 census carriers make the shipped predicate return a finding sentence, and a LIVE
sweep on this tree filed **60 rows**, every one independently confirmed by the census (zero
uncorroborated rows). Green: the one open carrier that DOES carry `needs-user-decision` (#17041,
2 questions) is silent; an earlier census at 03:07Z, with a fuller inbox, read 9 labelled
carriers and 0 reported.

> 4. **第 3 条落成一句可执行的规则**,写进 PM 协议:执行一次裁决时新产生的问题 ⇒ **另立卡并回链已裁卡**,⛔ 不得给已裁卡重挂 `needs-user-decision`。规则要说明理由(标签说不出"哪个问题",且母卡关闭会带走可见性)。

Two lines in the runbook, both reasons stated:

```
- 裁决执行中新生的问题另立卡并回链已裁卡,⛔ 不给已裁卡重挂 `needs-user-decision`。
- 理由两条:标签说不出是哪个问题;母卡一关就把这问题的可见性一起带走。
```

> 5. ⛔ **不改 `os-dev` 报告契约**(你已明写:数组是对的地方,缺的是读者)。

`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` is not in the diff — two files changed, nothing else.

> 6. **阴性对照**:一张 `open_questions` 为空数组的卡 ⛔ 不得被报出;一张已带 `needs-user-decision` 的卡 ⛔ 不得被重复报出。

Both are pinned self-test cases (`H52 negative control: …`) AND measured live: 22 open reports
and 615 closed reports carry an EMPTY `open_questions` and produce zero rows between them; the
labelled carrier produces none either. A third state is kept apart from both: a payload that
does not PARSE is UNJUDGED, never an empty array (3 open, 126 closed).

## The successor's first item — #13973's three residuals are ANSWERED, not lost

The triage ruling asked whoever picked this card up to establish where the three
`open_questions` of comment 5573240453 went, because a third instance would mean the defect had
struck again while this card was open. Comment **5577121900** (2026-09-08T00:17:34Z, director
seat, decision batch #80) records the maintainer's reply and rules all three **A, A, A — leave
as landed**, item by item. ⇒ No third instance.

⚠️ That ruling is also the reason the row over-reports on purpose: a ruling comment is not a
report, `isTriageRulingComment`'s anchor set does not match it, and teaching the row to
recognise a ruling would be a change to H33 rather than an addition beside it. A card answered
only in prose keeps firing until a later report writes `open_questions: []` or the label lands —
both repairs the board needs anyway, and the row's sentence asks for whichever applies.

## Verification

**Gate union — 42 derived, 42 run, 42 green.** Derived with
`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths
passed; the script took its own change set from the merge base) at HEAD `75b5ec0a7`, exit codes
captured by redirect before any pipe, then reconciled:

```
Run reconciliation — 42 derived, 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 42 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 42 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
```

Named in the dispatch and green: `check:pm-half-states` (self-test, **2856 cases pass**),
`check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:skill-frame-sync`,
`check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:nul-bytes`, plus `check:pm-dispatch-gates`.

**Ablation — the row can fail.** `h52OpenQuestionsUnrouted` was made to return `null`
unconditionally, the mutation proved on disk before the run (HEAD blob
`29babc062217aed2c77c658fcb1953c24cf1d5c0`, mutated blob
`55dac2ba3afeaf1f3e8484cda5c08f2a54d4b552`, marker occurrences 0 → 1), and the self-test went
**red: 25 of 2856 cases failed**, led by
`✗ H52 fires: a non-empty open_questions on a card with no needs-user-decision`. Restored with
`git checkout HEAD -- scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` under an `EXIT INT TERM` trap and proved
byte-identical (worktree blob back to `29babc06…`, `git diff HEAD` empty, marker occurrences 0),
then the self-test re-run green at 2856/2856. Negative-control cases stay green under the
mutation, which is what makes the 25 the row's own.

**Line budget (governed text).** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`
**241 → 241 lines** (ceiling 241, headroom 0), widest new line 110 bytes against the 120-byte
cap. ⛔ No ceiling raise and ⛔ no re-wrap: the two lines are paid for **inside the section that
gains them, by deleting content `SKILL.md` already carries** — the two-carriers line
(「一条裁决已记录的权威载体 = …摘要台账」 + 「卡上裁决评论是详注」, SKILL.md) and the
「时间戳加回忆不是引用」 clause (SKILL.md), whose one surviving increment — an id can be carried
and still not be retrievable — folds into the line above it, whose subject it already is. The
runbook's own header scopes it to increments over `SKILL.md`, so a line `SKILL.md` states is
not one. An earlier draft of this branch bought the same two lines by joining two unrelated
line pairs; that is a re-wrap, it deletes nothing, and it was reverted. No `skills/**`
(published package) file is in the diff, so that surface's two-reading budget does not apply.

**Governed surface.**

```
$ node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs \
    .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md
governed-surface predicate: 1 of 2 path(s) hit the register (5 surfaces, repo-agnostic).
  ⛔  GOVERNED — a human merge is the review record for this PR (#9495 regime).
      No seat flips it ready, enqueues it, or arms auto-merge (AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14).
      One hit governs the whole PR — 「混合 diff 一条命中即整 PR 分叉」; proportion is not a question.
      .claude/** ×1 — the agent instruction tree (skills, agents, hooks, settings)
        - .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md
  paths not on the register: scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs
(exit 3)
```

⇒ Draft, human merge. ⛔ Not readied, ⛔ not enqueued, ⛔ no auto-merge. `skip-changeset`: nothing
published moves — `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` are both off every package's `files[]`.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么。** 给"开发 agent 报告里那个写给您的问题"装了一个读者。过去 dev 把只有您能拍板的问题
写进报告的 `open_questions` 数组里,而收件箱只认 `needs-user-decision` 这枚标签 —— 数组里的问题
没有标签,于是它被规规矩矩地提交、然后谁也看不见。现在半状态巡查每轮会把这类卡列出来。同时在 PM
协议里写死一条规则:执行您的裁决过程中新冒出来的问题,另开一张卡并回链已裁的那张,⛔ 不许把标签重新
挂回已裁卡。

**为什么改。** 这不是"整洁"问题,是"您应得的一个决定从未到达"。本次普查第一次量出了洞的大小:
**65 张开放卡上压着 126 个问题,一个都不在收件箱里**;已关闭的卡上还有 255 张、436 个问题 ——
那一半连查询都查不到,因为卡一关,标签就跟着走了。已知最长的一例压了 17 天,而那张卡对应的部署
曾整整一天返回 503。这类失效不会自曝:dev 尽了责、报告通过校验、PM 接收了 —— 三个成功信号,一个
错误答案。

**风险与代价(含回滚)。** 代价接近零:这一行**不额外发一次请求**,只读别的巡查项已经买回来的评论
线程,读不到就明说"未判定",⛔ 不冒充干净;它也**不写任何标签、不阻塞任何东西**,只是巡查报告里
多一段清单。有一个**刻意保留的过度报告**:如果某个问题您已在卡上用中文回答、而没有人再补一份报告
或挂标签,这张卡会继续被列出来 —— 这是有意选的方向,因为它要求的两种收尾(该进收件箱的进收件箱,
已答的记一笔)都是看板本来就欠的。回滚成本:删掉这一行即可,零迁移、零数据形状变更;协议那两行同理。

**席位意见。** (留空,待席位定稿)

**你要做的。** 只有一个动作:**人工合并这个 PR**(受管面,⛔ 不入队、⛔ 不自动合并)。合并之后,
普查列出的那 65 张卡会由 PM 席位按新规则逐张归位 —— 不需要您逐张看。
